text: It does not get them all. Across every well on both plates it names the right mechanism in thirty percent of them, against a chance rate of ten. On vehicle controls it names nothing at all. Removing the paired design and nothing else drops that to nine percent, so the pairing is carrying most of it. The answer key and the failure conditions were written and hashed before a single recording was scored, and the whole sequence of scored runs is in the report, not just the best one.
